title: Moroccan-Style Plant-Based Mince Pizzas
subtitle: with Almonds and Mint
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Thinly slice the onion with a sharp knife or mandoline (see Kitchen 101). Pick the mint leaves and finely chop half the stems (you'll need about 2 tsp), discarding the remaining stems.

Pickle onion: Put 2 tbs white vinegar and 1 tbs sugar in a bowl, season with salt and stir to combine. Add the onion and toss to combine. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed. Meanwhile, put the almonds in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Brown plant-based mince: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Cook the mince, breaking up the lumps with a spoon, for 5-6 mins until browned. Add the Moroccan seasoning and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Remove the pan from the heat.
Bake pizzas: Put 2 pita on the lined tray. Spread with the tomato paste and top with the mince mixture. Bake the pizzas for 12 mins or until golden.

Serve up: Meanwhile, drain the onion, reserving the pickling liquid. Combine the chopped mint stems, 2 tsp reserved pickling liquid and 2 tbs vegan mayonnaise in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Top the pizzas with the pickled onion, mint leaves and almonds. Drizzle with the mint mayo, cut into wedges and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Get super-thin onion slices with a mandoline or use slow, fine strokes with a large sharp knife. The result is perfect for pickles!
